$comment: Reference list of Iligan City's 44 barangays. population_2024 and psgc_code are sourced from a citypopulation.de mirror of PSA data (the psa.gov.ph PSGC portal returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on 2026-09-02) and cross-checked against a second independent search (city total 368,132; Tubod 31,813) — verify against psa.gov.ph before treating as final. latitude/longitude are null for all barangays: no centroid coordinates were sourced from any citable dataset, and per project rule we do not invent coordinates. They require proper geocoding (e.g. NAMRIA/PhilGIS barangay boundary data or City GIS office) before use on the map.
